name: Camp K - Summer Day Camp
operator_name: City of Lebanon Recreation, Arts, and Parks
description_short: City-run summer day camp for children ages 5-11, held Monday-Friday 7:30 AM-5:00 PM at Lebanon Middle School. Campers are grouped by age and do swim lessons, arts and crafts, sports and games, and performances.
activities: Optional day trips (Camp K Hits the Road)
refund_policy_summary: A $20 deposit per week is non-refundable. The page gives no other refund terms.
special_needs_notes: Parents must disclose any physical, mental, emotional, social, developmental, or psychological conditions, plus medications and allergies, by June 8. The page does not describe any specific accommodations.
swim_waterfront_notes: Swim lessons at the Lebanon Veterans Outdoor Memorial Pool. Parents must give the camper's swim level.

warnings: Filled zip 03766 from the US Census geocoder (3 MOULTON AVE, LEBANON, NH, 03766)
The page shows the 2026 season (June 29 – August 7, 2026), which has already ended as of 2026-10-13. No 2027 dates or prices are posted yet.

Conflicting registration dates: the Quick Facts list resident registration on March 1, 2027 and non-resident on March 15, 2027, next to 2026 camp dates. Camp K Hits the Road shows March 2 and March 16, 2026. The page looks partly updated, so registration_opens_at was left blank for the weekly sessions.

The page does not list individual weeks. The six weekly sessions were worked out from the overall June 29 – August 7, 2026 date range and the weekly rate. They may not account for holidays (for example, July 3, 2026).
Session prices show the resident rate. Non-residents pay $225/week for Camp K and $90/day for Hits the Road.
Camp K Hits the Road is a separate optional trip program with separate registration, for ages 7–12, not 5–11.
The page also describes a Leader-In-Training program for ages 12–13. It is not recorded as a camper session.
